svg.text: VariLab | a better ELBO can give worse marginal means
Two spins with zero fields and J = 3. Exact means are (0, 0); exact cross-covariance is tanh(3) = 0.995055.
Product q cannot represent the target correlation. Symmetry-breaking chooses opposite modes from opposite starts.
Zero means stop after one sweep at a coordinate fixed point, but a joint perturbation raises ELBO: not a maximum.
Independent-control mean-error gate passes; positive-start coupled gate fails. Full model, states and histories embedded.
Hand-specified finite-model example, not an empirical benchmark. Exact enumeration uses floating-point log-sum-exp.
